paragraphs: I'm applying for the Engineering Intern, Security Platforms role in Sunnyvale. I like that your interns own a real feature from discovery to delivery, and the teams you list, from Integrations to the Unified Console's sign-in and access control, sit right where my experience is. I finished my B.S. in Computer Science at UC Irvine, specializing in Networked Systems, and I spend summers in Dublin, CA, so Sunnyvale is an easy commute.

Most of my hands-on work is on CommunicAI, an AI-powered iOS app I built and still run on the App Store, backed by Google Cloud and Node.js Cloud Functions. I own the backend end to end. The Cloud Functions enforce authentication, input validation and per-user and global rate limiting, and they verify Apple receipts to block subscription fraud. Sign-in covers Sign in with Apple (nonce plus SHA-256), Google OAuth and email/password with server-enforced verification, with Firebase App Check on every request. I wrote role-based access-control rules that stop IDOR, privilege escalation and message spoofing, and 36 adversarial unit tests try to break them.

I write Python, Java and JavaScript and use Git every day. My coursework covered computer networks, operating systems, and security and privacy, and in labs I used Wireshark to read network traffic and Burp Suite to test web apps. I'm also taking the CompTIA Security+ exam in January. As captain of UC Irvine's NCAA Division I track and field team, I'm used to taking feedback, communicating clearly and managing my time.
I'd like to spend the summer building something your customers use to see and contain threats. I'm available for Summer 2027, including either the May 24 or June 21 start.
